title: Introduction to HTML
description: Basic understanding of what HTML is and its structure.

quiz.question: What does HTML stand for?
quiz.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language and is used to create web pages.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to define the root element of an HTML document?
quiz.explanation: The `<html>` tag is the root element of an HTML page.

quiz.question: Where do you place metadata about the HTML document?
quiz.explanation: Metadata like the page title and links to CSS files go inside the `<head>` element.

quiz.question: Which tag contains the content visible to users in the browser?
quiz.explanation: The `<body>` tag contains all the visible content of the web page.

quiz.question: Which of the following is the correct doctype declaration for HTML5?
quiz.explanation: The correct declaration for HTML5 is `<!DOCTYPE HTML>`.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to add comments in HTML?
quiz.explanation: HTML comments are added using `<!-- comment text -->`.

quiz.question: What is the default language of an HTML document?
quiz.explanation: HTML itself is a markup language, but language attributes specify human language.

quiz.question: Which element is used to specify the title of the HTML document shown on the browser tab?
quiz.explanation: The `<title>` element inside `<head>` defines the title shown on the browser tab.

quiz.question: Which tag is used to define a paragraph in HTML?
quiz.explanation:
Paragraphs are defined with the `

quiz.question: Can HTML elements be nested inside one another?
quiz.explanation: HTML elements can be nested inside other elements to structure content.
